passage.text: Fon is a food influencer from Bangkok with more than a million followers.
passage.reading: ˈfɔːn ɪz ə ˈfuːd ˌɪnfluənsər frəm ˈbæŋkɑːk wɪð ˈmɔːr ðən ə ˈmɪljən ˈfɑːloʊərz.

passage.text: Five years ago, she started posting videos of street food stalls on social media.
passage.reading: ˈfaɪv ˈjɪrz əˈɡoʊ, ʃiː ˈstɑːrtɪd ˈpoʊstɪŋ ˈvɪdioʊz əv ˈstriːt ˌfuːd ˈstɔːlz ɑːn ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə.

passage.text: One of her videos went viral, and her life changed very quickly.
passage.reading: ˈwʌn əv hɜːr ˈvɪdioʊz ˈwɛnt ˈvaɪrəl, ənd hɜːr ˈlaɪf ˈtʃeɪndʒd ˈvɛri ˈkwɪkli.

passage.text: Today, big food companies sponsor her videos, and she earns more than a doctor.
passage.reading: təˈdeɪ, ˈbɪɡ ˈfuːd ˌkʌmpəniz ˈspɑːnsər hɜːr ˈvɪdioʊz, ənd ʃiː ˈɜːrnz ˈmɔːr ðən ə ˈdɑːktər.

passage.text: "People think my job is easy," she says, "but they don't see what happens behind the scenes."
passage.reading: ˈpiːpəl ˈθɪŋk maɪ ˈdʒɑːb ɪz ˈiːzi, ʃiː ˈsɛz, bʌt ðeɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈsiː ˈwʌt ˈhæpənz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈsiːnz.

passage.text: She works twelve hours a day: she visits restaurants, records videos, edits them and answers messages.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈwɜːrks ˈtwɛlv ˈaʊərz ə ˈdeɪ: ʃiː ˈvɪzɪts ˈrɛstərɑːnts, rɪˈkɔːrdz ˈvɪdioʊz, ˈɛdɪts ðɛm ənd ˈænsərz ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz.

passage.text: Fame has also changed her life in other ways.
passage.reading: ˈfeɪm hæz ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈtʃeɪndʒd hɜːr ˈlaɪf ɪn ˈʌðər ˈweɪz.

passage.text: "Strangers stop me in the street to take selfies," she says.
passage.reading: ˈstreɪndʒərz ˈstɑːp miː ɪn ðə ˈstriːt tə ˈteɪk ˈsɛlfiz, ʃiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: For Fon, the hardest part of the job is the pressure.
passage.reading: fər ˈfɔːn, ðə ˈhɑːrdɪst ˈpɑːrt əv ðə ˈdʒɑːb ɪz ðə ˈprɛʃər.

passage.text: "If I don't post every day, I lose followers, so I can never really take a break."
passage.reading: ɪf aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈpoʊst ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ, aɪ ˈluːz ˈfɑːloʊərz, soʊ aɪ kən ˈnɛvər ˈriːli ˈteɪk ə ˈbreɪk.

passage.text: She always tells her followers when a company has paid for a video.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈɔːlweɪz ˈtɛlz hɜːr ˈfɑːloʊərz wɛn ə ˈkʌmpəni hæz ˈpeɪd fər ə ˈvɪdioʊ.

passage.text: "Honesty is more important than money," she explains.
passage.reading: ˈɑːnəsti ɪz ˈmɔːr ɪmˈpɔːrtənt ðən ˈmʌni, ʃiː ɪkˈspleɪnz.

passage.text: Her advice for young people who want to become influencers? "Do it because you love it, not because you want to be famous."
passage.reading: hɜːr ədˈvaɪs fər ˈjʌŋ ˈpiːpəl huː ˈwɑːnt tə bɪˈkʌm ˈɪnfluənsərz? ˈduː ɪt bɪˈkɔːz juː ˈlʌv ɪt, ˈnɑːt bɪˈkɔːz juː ˈwɑːnt tə bi ˈfeɪməs.
